_: FACTS extracted from the NMX firmware dispatch. No code is copied (ADR-0003);
this is a table of command numbers, the firmware's own one-line comment, and a
payload-width hint inferred from which Node.nto* reader the case body uses.
serCamera / serKeyFrame, one entry per `case N:` reached by that handler.
Broadcast codes come from OMLibraries/OMMoCoBus/OMMoCoDefs.h (named enum,
not numeric cases, so they are transcribed rather than parsed).
A payload of null means the case body reads no argument, or reads one in a way
the extractor cannot classify — it is a hint, never a contract.
